name: Google Document Field Mapping
description: Maps one ERP (parent) field to a {{placeholder}} in the Google template.

fields.label: ERP Fieldname
fields.description: Fieldname on the source document, e.g. supplier_name. A single dotted hop through a Link is allowed, e.g. supplier_address.address_line1.

fields.label: Google Placeholder
fields.description: Placeholder text in the template. Defaults to {{erp_fieldname}} if left blank.

fields.label: Field Type
fields.options:
Data
Small Text
Text
Text Editor
Date
Datetime
Currency
Float
Int
Percent
Check
Link
Select
fields.description: Formatting hint. Blank = auto-detect from the source doctype.

fields.label: Default
fields.description: Used when the field is empty.

fields.label: Required
fields.description: If set and the placeholder is missing from the template, generation fails loudly.
